prompt.text:
Implement a new in-memory access-session module with no I/O. Export `Account`, `Session`, `SignInResult`, `signIn`, `signOut`, and `isAuthorized`. An account has `username`, `password`, and `disabled`; a session has `token` and `username`. `signIn(accounts, sessions, username, password, token)` returns `{ ok: true, sessions }` on success or `{ ok: false, reason, sessions }` where reason is `'invalid-credentials'`, `'disabled'`, or `'token-conflict'`. Blank username, password, or token counts as invalid credentials. Authentication requires an exact username and password match. A disabled matching account returns disabled. An existing token returns token-conflict. Success appends a copied session. `signOut` removes every session with the exact token. `isAuthorized` is true only when the token belongs to a session whose account still exists and is not disabled. All functions must leave arguments and nested objects unchanged and return fresh session objects. Preserve session order. Return a complete source file.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
